entities.summary: Cho Tae-yong is a South Korean career diplomat and politician with over three decades of experience who served as South Korea's National Security Advisor from March to December 2023. On January 16, 2024, he was appointed Director of the National Intelligence Service of South Korea, serving until June 2025.
